svg.desc: Composite score for each of the 215 runs, colored by eval version: run 9 cut the system prompt to one line and took quality from 73 to 100, the best kept score is 76.20 from run 26, and no eval v4 run scored above 63.70.
svg.text: Score by run. 215 runs, March 20 to 28, 2026.
One knob per run, keep or revert. Each point is one run, colored by eval version.
Run 9: system prompt cut to one line, quality 73 to 100
eval v4, 132 runs, Opus-distilled model, never above 63.70
